summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited consolidated financial statements (US equivalent: interim report on Form 6-K) as of September 30, 2026 and for the nine-month period then ended, prepared under Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards. The filing includes the board's responsibility statement signed by President Director Nanang Hendarno and Director of Finance and Risk Management Arthur Angelo Syailendra, dated Jakarta, October 30, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The only notable balance-sheet delta is an asset held for sale of 751 billion Rupiah at year-end 2025 dropping to nil by September 2026, hinting at a completed disposal, but the excerpt gives no terms. No deal or special-situations angle; routine periodic reporting.
